# Learn it, wire it, build it.

Step-by-step tutorials with wiring guides, downloadable code and interactive explanations — from your first Arduino project to wireless sensors and robots.

Search

[All](https://build.kadoshmechatronics.com/training) [ESP32 & ESP8266](https://build.kadoshmechatronics.com/training?category=ESP32%20%26%20ESP8266) [IoT](https://build.kadoshmechatronics.com/training?category=IoT) [Robotics](https://build.kadoshmechatronics.com/training?category=Robotics)

[![](https://buildapi.kadoshmechatronics.com/api/training/media/138809a0-c416-4b92-b831-87a844541325)RoboticsLatest\\
\\
**Build a line-following robot—and understand every steering decision** \\
\\
Wire an Arduino Uno, two reflectance sensors and a TB6612FNG driver. Calibrate with the motors disabled, explore steering interactively and run your first track with a repeatable test plan.\\
\\
5 min read·Beginner·40 viewsRead →](https://build.kadoshmechatronics.com/training/arduino-line-following-robot-two-sensors) [![](https://buildapi.kadoshmechatronics.com/api/training/media/ac869b48-ee90-4eb3-99e6-63210bce372f)IoT\\
\\
**Send sensor readings between two ESP32 boards—without a router** \\
\\
Build a direct ESP-NOW temperature-and-humidity link. Understand channels with an interactive packet demo, configure the receiver MAC and recognise missing or stale readings.\\
\\
5 min read·Beginner·35 viewsRead →](https://build.kadoshmechatronics.com/training/espnow-wireless-sensor-link-without-router) [![](https://buildapi.kadoshmechatronics.com/api/training/media/070cee41-3661-4bd2-bd0f-9c0d57f05835)ESP32 & ESP8266\\
\\
**Build an ESP32 water-tank monitor: see the level, understand the echo** \\
\\
Turn an ultrasonic echo into a useful water-level reading. Build a tabletop monitor, calibrate it, try the interactive tank and add a low-water alarm without alarm chatter.\\
\\
5 min read·Beginner·41 viewsRead →](https://build.kadoshmechatronics.com/training/esp32-water-tank-level-monitor)
